📖 How to use

  1. Add assignments with score, max points and weight %.
  2. Keep total weight at 100% for an accurate grade.
  3. See your weighted grade and letter grade below.
  4. Use the what-if tester to preview a score's effect.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I add assignments?

Add each assignment with its name, score earned, max points and weight %. Weights should add up to 100%.

How is the weighted grade calculated?

The weighted grade = Σ (score/max × weight). Each assignment contributes its fraction of the total proportionally to its weight.

How does the what-if tester work?

Type a hypothetical score into the What-if box and click Test — the grade updates without changing saved assignments.

Are my assignments saved?

Yes, in this browser's localStorage.
